name: nerd-font
description: Works out once whether a Nerd Font is installed, with a setting to force it on or off, so mods that draw Nerd Font glyphs know when to fall back

glyphs.title: Nerd Font glyphs
glyphs.description: auto: draw them when an installed font's family has "Nerd Font" in its name (fc-list). on or off: always or never, whatever is installed
